name: Group Theory Orbit Framing
description: The problem is reframed from linear algebra (vector subspace spanning) to group theory (symmetric group generation and orbits). The edges become transpositions, the tree guarantee becomes generating S_n with n-1 transpositions, and the target condition becomes placing elements in the same orbit. This forces models to bridge the gap between group theory concepts and graph connectivity, defeating superficial pattern matching on vector span phrasing.
